text: M02 `m02multidir` says `listMarkdownFiles(rootId)` scans the root's dir for the markdown entries `*.md`/`*.mdx` AND the raw entry `*.html` of the `pages` file map. In code (before and after the 2.1.7→2.1.8 window — the `before` text already listed `*.md`/`*.mdx`/`*.html`) `listMarkdownFiles()` on the `MarkdownFileStore` primitive (and forwarded by the `PagesService` facade) returns the markdown entries only: it is the listing every reader of page CONTENT walks — M06 section indexer and anchor injection, M08 todos, M14 links, M19 references, M17 initial `file_version` sync, frontmatter indexer, page search — and `.html` is a raw entry with track `none` that none of them may read (`resolveSafe` refuses non-markdown paths; an `.html` hit in page search or a `file_version` row for it would be a user-visible change). The raw `.html` entry IS covered per root by the tree walk (`PagesService.listTree`, `fileType` from the `pages` kind's file map) and served by M30. Making `listMarkdownFiles` return `.html` would change search results and capture, and contradicts the existing test `pages.mdx.test.ts` ('includes .mdx in listMarkdownFiles (feeds search + M06 reindex), excludes .html/.txt'), so the build keeps markdown-only. Suggestion: reword the sentence so `listMarkdownFiles(rootId)` lists the markdown entries (`*.md`/`*.mdx`), and the root's tree (listTree) is what also shows the raw `*.html` entry — or name the full file-map listing separately if one is wanted.
assumption: ASSUMPTION:dev-0004 — `listMarkdownFiles` lists markdown entries only; the raw `.html` entry is covered per root by the tree walk, not by this listing.
